title: OpenEPCIS Textile DPP Vocabulary Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating Textile Digital Product Passport data per EU Sustainable Textiles Strategy, ESPR 2024/1781, and EU Preparatory Study 3rd Milestone. Version 0.9.6.

TextileProduct.title: Textile Product
TextileProduct.description: A textile product as defined by EU Textile Labelling Regulation 1007/2011.

hasFabricType.description: Recommended — fabric construction type; product classification under the Textile Labelling Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 and the ESPR textile delegated act.

garmentType.description: Specific type of garment (jacket, trousers, shirt, etc.).

seasonCollection.description: Season and year of the collection.

textileMaterial.description: Fibre composition as gs1:TextileMaterialDetails, one entry per fibre, extended with the eutex traceability properties.

hasCareInstructions.description: Recommended — care labelling per ISO 3758 (GINETEX care symbols); usage-information data point of the ESPR textile DPP.

hasDurabilityInfo.description: Recommended — durability/robustness metrics per the JRC textile preparatory study (3rd Milestone) and the ESPR Annex I durability parameters.

hasRecycledContentDeclaration.description: Recommended — structured recycled content declaration per ESPR Art. 7 and the EU Strategy for Sustainable and Circular Textiles (COM/2022/141).

hasEnvironmentalFootprint.description: Recommended — environmental footprint declaration (PEF apparel & footwear) mandated by the ESPR 2024/1781 textile delegated act.

hasSubstancesOfConcern.description: Recommended — substances of concern present in the product per the ESPR Art. 7(5) tracking duty.

isRepairable.description: Recommended — repairability flag per the ESPR Annex I reparability parameter and the EU circular-textiles strategy (COM/2022/141).

hasSpinningFacility.description: Facility where fiber was spun into yarn. Uses oec:FacilityInformation pattern.

hasWeavingFacility.description: Facility where yarn was woven or knitted into fabric. Uses oec:FacilityInformation pattern.

hasDyeingFacility.description: Facility where fabric was dyed or printed. Uses oec:FacilityInformation pattern.

hasCutAndSewFacility.description: Facility where garment was cut and assembled. Uses oec:FacilityInformation pattern.

hasFinishingFacility.description: Facility where finishing treatments were applied. Uses oec:FacilityInformation pattern.

TextileCategory.title: Textile Category
TextileCategory.description: Categories of textile products per EU Textile Labelling Regulation.

FabricType.title: Fabric Type
FabricType.description: Fabric construction type per EU Preparatory Study.

ApparelSubcategory.title: Apparel Subcategory
ApparelSubcategory.description: Apparel subcategories per EU Preparatory Study 3rd Milestone.

DurabilityInfo.title: Durability Information
DurabilityInfo.description: Durability assessment: each test an oea:TestExecution under hasSubAssessment (eutex:MartindaleAbrasionTest, PillingTest, ColourFastnessTest, DimensionalChangeTest, TensileStrengthTest, TearStrengthTest); wash cycles, lifetime and durability class are indicators. See common/assessment (oea:).

hasMethod.description: oea:hasMethod: the assessment method, the IRI of a published oea:AssessmentMethod individual or an inline method.

hasSubAssessment.description: oea:hasSubAssessment: the tests of a composite assessment (oea:TestExecution objects).

hasIndicator.description: oea:hasIndicator: oea:Indicator object(s) for scores, classes and expected lifetimes.

RobustnessAssessment.title: Robustness Assessment
RobustnessAssessment.description: JRC robustness assessment (hasMethod eutex:JRCRobustnessScoring): 5 cleaning cycles as parameter setting, fabric type as condition, three sub-assessments with awarded points, the 0-10 score as an eutex:RobustnessScore indicator. See common/assessment (oea:).

hasMethod.description: oea:hasMethod: the assessment method, the IRI of a published oea:AssessmentMethod individual or an inline method.

hasSubAssessment.description: oea:hasSubAssessment: the tests of a composite assessment (oea:TestExecution objects).

hasIndicator.description: oea:hasIndicator: oea:Indicator object(s) for scores, classes and expected lifetimes.

RecyclabilityAssessment.title: Recyclability Assessment
RecyclabilityAssessment.description: JRC recyclability assessment (hasMethod eutex:JRCRecyclabilityScoring): elastane content result against eutex:ElastaneContentLimit, one criterion result per sorting criterion and for technical recyclability, the 0-10 score as an oea:RecyclabilityScore indicator, hasOutcome for recyclable. See common/assessment (oea:).

hasMethod.description: oea:hasMethod: the assessment method, the IRI of a published oea:AssessmentMethod individual or an inline method.

hasSubAssessment.description: oea:hasSubAssessment: the tests of a composite assessment (oea:TestExecution objects).

hasIndicator.description: oea:hasIndicator: oea:Indicator object(s) for scores, classes and expected lifetimes.

hasApplicableRecyclingTechnology.description: Recycling technology the assessment applies to.

hasMethod.description: Method the assessment applied (oea:hasMethod): an individual naming the test or calculation method and its standard.

hasResult.description: Results the assessment produced (oea:hasResult): measurement, criterion or categorical results.

hasSubAssessment.description: Component assessments (oea:hasSubAssessment), e.g. the individual tests of a composite score.

hasIndicator.description: Indicators derived from the results (oea:hasIndicator): scores, classes, expected lifetimes.

hasOutcome.description: Overall outcome against the applicable criteria (oea:hasOutcome).

RecyclingTechnology.title: Recycling Technology
RecyclingTechnology.description: Applicable recycling technologies per EU Preparatory Study.

RecycledContentDeclaration.title: Recycled Content Declaration
RecycledContentDeclaration.description: Structured recycled content declaration per EU Preparatory Study 3rd Milestone.

EnvironmentalFootprint.title: Environmental Footprint
EnvironmentalFootprint.description: Environmental footprint per PEFCR Apparel & Footwear, an oea:Assessment.

hasMethod.description: oea:hasMethod: the PEFCR applied, an oea:AssessmentMethod (inline with oea:methodName, e.g. 'PEFCR Apparel & Footwear v1.3').

hasIndicator.description: oea:hasIndicator: oea:Indicator object(s) of kind eutex:ManufacturingCarbonFootprint (KGM), eutex:PEFSingleScore (mPt, C62), eutex:BenchmarkPerformance (P1), eutex:CarbonFootprintClass or eutex:EnvironmentalFootprintClass (C62).

LCIACategory.title: LCIA Category
LCIACategory.description: Individual Life Cycle Impact Assessment category result, an oea:MeasurementResult.

hasMeasuredValue.description: oea:hasMeasuredValue: gs1:QuantitativeValue with the UN/CEFACT unitCode of the reference substance (KGM, C34, MTQ; C62 for CTUe/CTUh).

declaredUnit.description: oec:declaredUnit: the unit as stated, e.g. 'kg CO2-eq'.

SubstanceOfConcern.title: Substance of Concern
SubstanceOfConcern.description: A substance of concern classified per ESPR Article 7(5) 4-type system.

MicroplasticInfo.title: Microplastic Information
MicroplasticInfo.description: Microfibre release assessment (hasMethod eutex:MicrofibreReleaseTest): the release as a result observing eutex:MicrofibreRelease, the risk band as an eutex:SheddingRiskLevel indicator. See common/assessment (oea:).

hasMethod.description: oea:hasMethod: the assessment method, the IRI of a published oea:AssessmentMethod individual or an inline method.

hasSubAssessment.description: oea:hasSubAssessment: the tests of a composite assessment (oea:TestExecution objects).

hasIndicator.description: oea:hasIndicator: oea:Indicator object(s) for scores, classes and expected lifetimes.

TakeBackProgram.title: Take-Back Program
TakeBackProgram.description: End-of-life collection and take-back program information.

RepairService.title: Repair Service
RepairService.description: Information about repair services available for the product.

TextileChemical.title: Textile Chemical
TextileChemical.description: A chemical substance used in textile production.

QuantitativeValue.title: Quantitative Value
QuantitativeValue.description: A point value or interval for measurement (gs1:QuantitativeValue).

TextileMaterialDetails.title: Textile Material Details
TextileMaterialDetails.description: One fibre of the composition (gs1:TextileMaterialDetails) with the eutex traceability extensions.

textileMaterialDescription.description: Fibre name, a language-tagged string or a list of them (gs1:textileMaterialDescription).

textileMaterialPercentage.description: Share of this fibre by mass, in percent (gs1:textileMaterialPercentage).

fiberOrigin.description: Country or region of fiber origin (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code).

recycledContentSource.description: Source of recycled content (pre-consumer, post-consumer, ocean plastic, etc.).

hasFiberCertification.description: Certification specific to this fiber using gs1:CertificationDetails pattern.
